lines.en: Grumbles softly
Slowly swims towards darker areas
Gently taps its fin

lines.zh: 用鳃呼吸水面下的空气
lines.en: Breathes air from the surface with gills
Attempts to ignore the player
Rapidly swims away suddenly
Flickers with light in water
Gently touches its fin for balance

lines.zh: 在岩石缝隙中寻找食物
lines.en: Scours cracks for food

lines.zh: 我沿着礁石边，缓缓摆尾。
lines.en: I glide along the reef edge with a slow tail beat.
My scales slice the dim water.
My fins sweep past a sunken wreck.
Stops motionless in water
Gently taps its fin for relaxation
Slowly flaps its fin
Floats on the surface

lines.zh: 偶尔发出微弱的嗡嗡声
lines.en: Occasionally grumbles softly
My gemmed fin glimmers, bright then dim.
Carefully watches surroundings
Slightly changes color
Floats in the dark
Remains still to avoid notice
I hang still in the cold current.
I read the water with my lateral line.
I work my jaw, breathing slow.
I doze against the gravel floor.

lines.zh: 我把半张脸藏在礁石缝里。
lines.en: I hide half my face in the reef crevice.
Rapidly swims towards the player
Gently taps its fin, remaining alert
Swims towards the player's reflection
Quickly averts its gaze from the player
Approaches the player stealthily
Hides eyes behind its fin
Nervously watches the player
Issues a low warning growl
One flash of my gem fins and I'm closer.
I look up at you from the bottom.
I study you from the lily shadow.
One eye never leaves you.
I circle the feet you dangle.
Your lantern draws me close.
I watch you from just under the surface.
My fin nudges the water rings.
I stop still by the bank.
Fin hurt!

lines.zh: 我的鳍被划开，水都变咸了。
lines.en: My fin is sliced open, and the water turns salty.
Antenna hurt!
My gem-bright scales cracked.
Scale hurt!

lines.zh: 尾鳍一沉，我游得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My tail fin sinks, and I swim crookedly.
Fin broken!
Body stuck!
Antenna stuck!
Eye stuck!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着宝石般的光芒，诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: Its gem-like eyes tempt you closer.

lines.zh: 它的鳍像光点般闪烁，吸引着你。
lines.en: Its fins flash like lights, drawing you in.

lines.zh: 靠近它，你会感受到它的诱惑力。
lines.en: Approach it, and feel its allure.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的光芒，像是在邀请你。
lines.en: It emits a weak light, beckoning you.

lines.zh: 它的身体反射出迷人的光芒，让你无法移开视线。
lines.en: Its body glows enticingly, captivating your gaze.

lines.zh: 不要让好奇心引导你接近。
lines.en: Let curiosity not guide you closer.

lines.zh: 它的光芒引诱着你，你几乎要跳进水中。
lines.en: Its light lures you, almost drawing you in.

lines.zh: 它的诱惑如此强烈，几乎让人无法抗拒。
lines.en: Its temptation is so strong, almost irresistible.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在黑暗中回荡，引诱着你前进。
lines.en: Its call echoes in the dark, drawing you forward.

lines.zh: 它的光芒和声音都充满了诱惑。
lines.en: Its light and sounds are full of temptation.

lines.zh: 它突然撞向你，让你猝不及防。
lines.en: It suddenly collides with you, catching you off guard.

lines.zh: 它的体型让你难以避开它的攻击。
lines.en: Its size makes it hard to avoid its attack.

lines.zh: 它以惊人的速度冲撞过来，让你措手不及。
lines.en: It rushes at you with surprising speed, leaving you caught off guard.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞力量让你感到震撼。
lines.en: Its collision is a force to be reckoned with.

lines.zh: 它用鳍猛烈地撞击你，力道惊人。
lines.en: It strikes you with its fins, with surprising force.

lines.zh: 它的撞击几乎让你失去平衡。
lines.en: Its collision almost unbalances you.

lines.zh: 它猛烈地撞向你，试图把你击退。
lines.en: It forcefully collides with you, trying to push you back.

lines.zh: 它的突然撞击让你防不胜防。
lines.en: Its sudden collision leaves you unprepared.

lines.zh: 它的身体如同子弹般撞击过来。
lines.en: Its body strikes like a bullet.

lines.zh: 它以迅雷不及掩耳之势撞向你。
lines.en: It collides with you in a blinding flash.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的叫声，吸引着伴侣。
lines.en: It calls out for a mate, drawing another in.

lines.zh: 它的叫声充满求爱的意味。
lines.en: Its call is filled with mating intent.

lines.zh: 它用优雅的动作吸引配偶。
lines.en: It uses graceful movements to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为让人难以忽视。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is hard to ignore.

lines.zh: 它发出特有的求偶叫声，吸引同类。
lines.en: It emits a specific call for mating, drawing同类s in.

lines.zh: 它试图吸引伴侣，展示它的美丽。
lines.en: It tries to attract a mate by showing off its beauty.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声在水中回荡。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes in the water.

lines.zh: 它通过求偶舞蹈吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It attracts a mate through a mating dance.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为充满激情。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is passionate.

lines.zh: 它用独特的舞步吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It attracts a mate with unique steps.

lines.zh: 闪着蓝光的鱼游了过来
lines.en: A glowing blue fish swims over

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在黑暗中闪耀
lines.en: Its scales shine in the darkness
Gem Fin approaches slowly
Its fins reflect a eerie glow

lines.zh: 鱼鳍上的宝石亮了一下。
lines.en: The gem on my fin just glinted.
Its mouth opens slightly
It swims towards the light

lines.zh: 宝石鳍鱼发出微弱的叫声
lines.en: Gem Fin makes a faint noise

lines.zh: 鱼鳞在水面留下闪亮轨迹
lines.en: Its scales leave a bright trail on the water
It starts circling you
You are its target
It stares intently at you
Its fins flash in the dark
It prepares to attack
You feel a chill

lines.zh: 鱼身上的鳞片闪闪发亮
lines.en: Its scales gleam

lines.zh: 它的眼睛变得异常明亮
lines.en: Its eyes glow brightly
It speeds closer

lines.zh: 鱼嘴发出微弱的呼吸声
lines.en: Its mouth makes a faint breath sound
Its body starts to glow
Blood has entered the water.
Something struggles at the bank.
The ripples give it away.
I hear a splash.
That shadow draws nearer.
Today's prey has waded in.
It watches you
Its fins tap the water gently
Its gaze is filled with malice
It swims to your position
Its tail swings in the water
It seems to be thinking
Its mouth starts to move

lines.zh: 它的身体开始轻微扭曲
lines.en: Its body starts to contort
It begins to hum lowly
Its fins create ripples in the water
I sink beneath its feet and wait.
I slip along the weeds.
I fold my fins to stay silent.
I tighten my circle.
I wait for it to bend and drink.
I aim for its ankle.
The current carries it to me.
My gills flare as I hold myself back.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶……”，宝石鳍鱼游了过来，口中满是锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Sssss… The Gem Fin approaches, its teeth bared.

lines.zh: 小心，它的鳍如刀刃般锋利！
lines.en: Beware, its fins are razor-sharp!

lines.zh: 它的皮肤闪烁着宝石般的光芒。
lines.en: Its skin glitters with gemstone-like light.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛里闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with a greedy light.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴拍打着水面，发出啪啪声。
lines.en: Its tail slaps the water, making a pattering sound.

lines.zh: 宝石鳍鱼的鳞片在阳光下闪耀。
lines.en: The Gem Fin's scales shimmer in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 它以暗藏锋芒的嘴攻击你。
lines.en: It attacks with its fanged mouth.
Its voice is low and dangerous.

lines.zh: 宝石鳍鱼迅速逼近，准备攻击。
lines.en: The Gem Fin closes in for the attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧紧盯着你的弱点。
lines.en: Its eyes lock onto your vulnerabilities.
I burst up out of the water.
My teeth rake its leg.
My fin edge opens the skin.
My tail drags it under.
I churn the water to blind it.
I bite and do not let go.

lines.zh: 黑暗中突然出现一道宝石光芒。
lines.en: A gem light appears out of the darkness.

lines.zh: 一束宝石光芒划破黑夜。
lines.en: A beam of gem light cuts through the night.

lines.zh: 神秘的宝石光芒中孵化出新生命。
lines.en: A new life hatches from the mysterious gem light.

lines.zh: 宝石光芒里藏着一只饥饿的宝石鳍鱼。
lines.en: A hungry Gem Fin hides within the gem light.

lines.zh: 光芒中显现出宝石鳍鱼的身影。
lines.en: A Gem Fin appears within the light.

lines.zh: 一束光芒降落在水中，孵化出宝石鳍鱼。
lines.en: A beam of light lands in the water, hatching a Gem Fin.

lines.zh: 宝石光芒中诞生出新的生物。
lines.en: A new creature is born from the gem light.

lines.zh: 黑暗中突然闪烁起宝石光芒。
lines.en: A gem light suddenly flickers in the darkness.

lines.zh: 一颗宝石在黑暗中渐渐孵化出宝石鳍鱼。
lines.en: A gem hatches a Gem Fin in the darkness.

lines.zh: 宝石光芒中逐渐现出宝石鳍鱼的轮廓。
lines.en: The outline of a Gem Fin slowly appears within the gem light.

lines.zh: 深水里亮起一点宝石光
lines.en: A gem light kindles in the deep.
Something stirs under the stones.
The water turns a shade colder.
The school scatters, I have come.
A new hunter leaves the wreck.
A soft click rises from the riverbed.
A gem fin takes shape in the dark.
A glimmer joins the weeds.

lines.zh: 水都烧开了，烫得我乱窜
lines.en: The water boils and I thrash in pain.

lines.zh: 从瀑布上摔下来，鳞都翻了
lines.en: I fell down the falls and my scales flipped.

lines.zh: 离了水，我张着嘴也喘不上气
lines.en: Out of water, my open mouth finds no air.

lines.zh: 水底的爆响震得我翻白肚
lines.en: An underwater blast rolls me belly-up.

lines.zh: 宝石鳍也被射穿了一块。
lines.en: A shard of my gem fin got shot through.

lines.zh: 魔法灼过鳞片，我缩了一下。
lines.en: Magic scorches my scales, and I flinch.
Hungry enough to graze the moss below.

lines.zh: 鳍上的宝石被劈得发白。
lines.en: The gem on my fin went white from the bolt.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，宝石光也灭了
lines.en: Falling into the void, my gem light dies.
